avis.texte: My new go-to face sunscreen. It has never failed me and I love the feel of it! Also does not run into my eyes which I had problems with other sunscreens

Being older, I need better skin protection and Sun Bum does a good job. Goes on easy and is absorbed quickly. Also, since it's made for the face, I don't get any burning of the eyes or bad taste if I inadvertently get it in my mouth.

I really love the high spf 70, its thin and runny so it feels light going on! I love that it's geared towards not clogging pores sonits great for my acne prone skin. Cleanse thorougly. Im not sure why people complain they look shiny or something, healthy skin plus your skincare is meant to hydrate and moisturize so tour skin will glow with this added on top. People who want matte skin shouls buy a translucent powder and problem solved. Yes it has stung my eyes if it gets close but I expect that with every chemical sunscreen but i can't stand mineral.

Honestly, this is SUCH a good sunscreen. It doesn't burn my eye even when I put it on my eyelids, and its not greasy or heavy at all even as an oily skinned person. And absolutely NO whitecast. Love it so much.

Smooth and creamy, this lightweight heavyweight is not drying to my very dry skin. It glides on and is absorbed quickly - no white streaks! This is my first time using Sun Bum on my face, and I am sold.
It works well and i want to like it, but it really irritates my eyes. Ive even tried applying it well away from my eyes, but it migrates throughout the day and stings/irritates my eyes badly.

avis.titre: Pretty good for no makeup days
avis.texte: There isn't a white-cast and it feels really moisturizing. I don't agree with them marketing it as a matte finish, but it does seem like a nice SPF.

This sunscreen looks greasy (even on my dry skin), feels disgusting and makes my hair stick to my face, and smells a little weird on top of it. The one that's formulated for all over is MUCH better and one of the best drugstore sunscreens I've tried.

I love trying new sunscreens and this one I ALWAYS come back to! It's affordable, leaves ZERO white casts, and works sooooo well under makeup! I will always be a loyal customer of all Sun Bum products!!

The texture and consistency of this product is strange. Its so runny when getting it out of the tube, like it gets everywhere. Then when you actually apply it to the skin it is so sticky. Then trying to put it ontop of my preferred moisturizer is just a mess. It is messy, sticky, and weird. All that said, i didnt get sunburn.

avis.titre: I keep coming back to this one!!
avis.texte: I have tried so many face sunscreens and this is the one I always come back to! It doesn't irritate my eyes, it provides great protection and wont sweat off on hot and humid days.
These things last forever and do not have a strong sunscreen smell. The only con is it can make your skin really oily for about 2 hours after aplication so a little goes a long way for me.
I have used this product so much over the years, and it is a lifesaver! I use it whenever I am out in the sun, and it works like a charm, I never get sunburned after using this! Thank you Sun Bum!!

avis.titre: Never going back after buying this
avis.texte: I've been trying to find a good spf moisturizer and this one is exactly what I was looking for. I wear makeup on top of this moisturizer and since it is slightly tacky my makeup sticks better than when I use a primer!

I left this product out in the sun for 30 minutes and it completely melted. Its not the same as it was at all. This product it so greasy on my face and it adds on to the oiliness. Good for body but not for face, although it didnt break me out or anything bad.
Sun Bum face lotion with SPF 70 goes on easily and is not too "greasy" or chalky. I use it on my face and chest area and it's been working well.
I have been on the hunt for a non-greasy sunblock for about 10 years. I finally found it, I love that the SPF is 70. No greesy feeling, no breakouts, doesnt get into my eyes and burn like others.
I really like this sunscreen, i putbit on everyday and have not broken out like with other sunscreens. I dont get too oily with it.
Ive been using sunbum for a year. Im always out in the feild educating children or doing conservation. Constantly sweating and it does not cause breakouts

The product comes out too quickly but spreads easily. Once it begins to be absorbed by the skin, it turns dry. It does not "sweat" much & that is good. Protection is assured, until you wet the skin & towel off.

I have been searching for a good facial sunscreen for what seems like forever and it seems that the search is still on after trying this product. This sunscreen is terrible! It is extremely greasy and oily and pills so bad, leaving little white balls all over your face that you have to pick off individually-they dont rub in no matter how bad you try. This sunscreen doesnt melt into your skin well at all and feels like vaseline is slathered all over your face. I absolutely do not recommend this product, especially if you have acne or oily skin.

First of all it stinks, second it is unpleasant to apply. It feels sticky and almost like a mineral sunscreen when you apply it. Not enjoyable to use at all. Besides that it provides very good SPF and I didn't burn at all being all day at Knotts Berry Farm.
I work a trail tech and outdoor educator and this sunscreen is the best sunscreen ! It does not irritate my eyes when I sweat. Does not irritate my face its amazing

avis.titre: Love this sunscreen! Have purchased over and over.
avis.texte: This sunscreen is my absolute favorite. I use this under my makeup every single day and even when I don't wear makeup. No white cast and not greasy at all.
This sunblock is wonderful! It is lightweight, fragrance free, doesn't break out my sensitive skin! I started wearing this after I had some Basil Cell Carcinoma removed.

this spf isn't too expensive, has a light smell, leaves the skin with a nice glow without looking oily and i like that it's super lightweight, slightly tacky and has a watery consistency because it makes a good base for makeup!! i have sensitive acne prone skin and this spf doesn't freak my skin out!!

I have acne prone skin triggered by sunscreens. Most sunscreens make my face red and this is one of the few that doesn't (for a decent price especially). This is my go to sunscreen. I wish they sold a bigger size but this usually last me the whole summer.

avis.titre: Possibly my Holy Grail of sunblock
avis.texte: I wear sunblock —. 60 SPF — or higher daily, under my makeup. But I also tend to have oily skin and even "oil free" sunblocks leave a slick feeling. This does not. It's thin, lightweight, odorless (as far as I can tell), a high enough SPF for my needs. You have to shake it before using it, and then let it set before applying makeup — but I like it enough to use it every single day, liberally.

i picked up this sunscreen in the hopes it'd work for me (i have pretty fair skin as well as a painful allergy to sunscreens) and this worked perfect. i applied it once in the morning and was out in the sun for about 10 hours and didn't burn, have a reaction, or have white streaks. i will definitely be using this as my new daily sunscreen :)

avis.titre: I will definitely be buying this product again.
avis.texte: I have bought this for my skin care routine for a couple years now and I still love it. It is lightweight and it's also very moisturizing for it being a sunscreen. I have also bought it for my boyfriend and I always take it with me when we travel. It's easy for on the go and everyone could use it.

I love that it's spf 70 and cheap. The formula itself is very milky but once you apply it you do feel it. I love the finish bc it acts as a primer! It keeps my makeup on through the 100s heat and doesn't pill and so happy there's no white cast. love love love!

I usually get the Sunbum 50 but I wanted to get a stronger SPF. When I first applied it, these white balls would pile up and take a while to spread out. Also, this leaves my skin feeling really greasy. Very unfortunate and I might reconsider this brand.

I use this product every day as part of my skin care routine. Some might say that it is greasy, but I think it gives more of a dewy look. It should be noted that I have dry to normal skin. It has not caused me to break out. It does not have a scent and it is really light weight which I love. It does not leave a white cast either. I have tried other more expensive sunscreens and I prefer this one over the others. Also it does really well under make up. I read some of the other reviews about it leaving white filaments that you have to peel off, but I've never had that issue.

This sunscreen leaves little pieces of white "peels" all over your face when applying, you have to pick them off. Also I think this is what is causing me to break out, I have acne prone skin. This is not for my oily skin girlies at all it has me looking like a literal greaseball. Smells good tho so ehh..? might just use for body.
So hard to spread greasy and it left little balls of white … peels
I have very sensitive acne prone skin and this made my skin burn, so not using it again.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I started using this product daily after applying moisturizer. My skin didn't feel dry through the day or sticky . But one thing I noticed is that I'm starting to break out on forehead but not on the rest of my face. I still love this product I'm still using it I recommend it for a daily sunblock.

I started a retinol recently, and needed a broad spectrum sunscreen to layer between my skincare and foundation. This product is the perfect texture! It's a thinner formula than normal sunscreen and goes on smooth like a serum. Leaves me with a nice glow but not greasy. I'm about to our foundation or tinted moisturizer over it and it doesn't pill or feel heavy. Just make sure you give it about 5 minutes to settle before you put anything on top!

I was looking for a sunscreen with a high SPF for everyday use, got this one because of the good reviews. Originally, I was going to get the bigger version of it, but I didn't see it say if it was ok to use for face so I settled for this one instead. The consistency is runny which I don't mind, I find that it makes me use less when I combine it with my ordinary face lotion. No white overcast on my face, it does leave me looking a bit shiny but that's fine, it's something I can blot off with a napkin throughout the day. I'm giving this 2 stars because I believe it is making my skin breakout like crazy, even on parts of my face that don't break out usually. I do have acne prone skin so I was really hoping the 'break out free ' label on the sunscreen would be a good match for me. Not sure what ingredient is causing it, I've never had a reaction like that towards sunscreen. I'm repurposing the sunscreen to use directly over my body tattoos, since it's only my face that is having a reaction to it. I would recommend this to those who want to use it as body sunscreen, or if you don't have sensitive skin.
I'm very sensitive to how sunscreen feels on my face and this doesn't feel super oily and gross like many others. It WILL burn your eyes though, so avoid that area.

It's an ok sunscreen it works, good to reapply, but like any other chemical sunscreen, it would run into your eyes and mouth. I live in a desert climate and have oily skin, it dries ok in like 30 mins to an hour, but it is still a bit greasy on the face.

avis.titre: Great for my easily dry, irritated skin!
avis.texte: I have had a tough time finding a sun block that didn't irritate my sensitive skin until I found this product. I use it every day and have no problems with it whatsoever. It doesn't dry my face out their!
We love SunBum products and have started using them exclusively! Wonderful formula, always protects - even for our redhead!

I'm so disappointed. I absolutely love Sun bum products. Ran out of my usual face sunscreen, so of course got this. It is greasy and heavy and does not stay put. Our faces kept getting burnt on our recent vacation, no matter how many times we reapplied! Body, neck and arms were fine with the SPF 70. Finally just started using the regular Sun Bum on our faces too and stopped getting burnt. Threw the face sunscreen away immediately!
i use this as my daily moisturizer and it always leaves my skin feeling refreshed and glowing, i love the way it makes my skin look!!
First time trying this product and I'm liking it. Feels great to know I'm getting extra protection for my face. Its great that it dries matte and it doesn't feel too heavy under a little foundation.
I really like how it feels in my face, the smell is amazing too. I‚'m happy that I have my skin protected all the day.
I love the way it feels on my skin and it does not break me out! Minus 1 star because it is a little runny, but I don‚'t mind!
This sunscreen is great except for the fact that it's really liquid-y which makes it a little harder to apply but overall it's great!

I‚'m always sensitive to sunscreens but thought this would be a good product to try. After wearing it all day and washing it off at night, I woke up the next morning and my whole face was swollen!!! It gave me a chemical burn ): please be safe using this. not good for sensitive skin
It is very greasy but it goes away after rubbing it in for a bit and it does not leave your face looking white after. Def will be buying again.

I'm not sure what ingredient is making it feel heavy, but it's also breaking me out. I have simplified my skincare, and was doing great till I used this product under a week. Now I gotta clear up my skin again and find a better spf.
It's very thin and therefore messy. After using it left a greasy feeling. Made my skin look Very shiny after using. Not happy with this product.
I'm on my third or fourth tube. It goes on nice and doesn't give me an allergic reaction.

The higher the SPF the better! Provides the protection I need and most importantly, this formulation is paraben, phthalate, oxybenzone and retinyl palmitate free. Also reasonably priced for the amount you get.
Doesn't break me out. I wear it underneath make up with translucent powder and it doesn't leave me looking oil. The smell is a plus! I love the sun bun scent.

Its thin in your hand but once you start spreading it feels a little thicker. It dries fast so move just as quickly. Does have a shine to it but I always blot afterward and that seems to help. I have super sensitive skin, I've used this for over two months now and I haven't reacted badly. Definitely worth a try. :)

I gave this two stars because I believe it could be a good option for someone who doesn't have skin sensitivities. It's a good price and it has ingredients that are better for the environment, but unfortunately this broke me out. It is a little greasy going on, so I wouldn't recommend it for under makeup but I didn't notice a lasting white cast. I did not feel any irritation or sensitivity when wearing this, but I noticed I was breaking out in small pimples all over my face after a few days of usage. I wouldn't recommend this to someone with any cosmetic sensitivities but in general it's a fair price and a decent sunscreen.
It can feel pretty heavy if I need to reapply. I gave it 2 since it doesn't break me out. It will also occasionally make my eyes burn pretty badly so I won't be repurchasing

avis.titre: I have combination skin, but love this sunscreen.
avis.texte: As someone with combination skin that's a little more on the oily side I was afraid of a form of daily facial sunscreen such as this. Before I would use CeraVe moisturizer with spf, but I wanted a higher spf. I would normally only use this in the summer when I would be out in the sun. I love this! It doesn't give me a white cast, I am pale though, but I still recommend trying even with a darker complexion. Just rub it in your hands to warm it up and then apply and rub it into the skin. If it doesn't work you can always return it. It doesn't make me overly oily either, there isn't any excess oil that I don't normally produce. It has a regular sunscreen scent, but I can't smell it at all once applied. It also doesn't affect my makeup whatsoever, just always remember to let your skincare absorb before going in with makeup. I hope this lengthy review helps someone! :)

This sunscreen has a lot going for it! I love that it's an spf 70 (I don't grab anything less then 30). It is very runny so keep that in mind when you open the tube. It might come pouring out if you aren't careful. To me there is not noticeable smell or fragrance. I love that it's 3oz instead of the usual 1oz for facial sunscreens. If you're using it frequently then 1oz gets used up very quick. I do notice a tacky feeling after applying that doesn't quite go away, but that's not a problem for me. If you wear makeup overtop you might even like the tacky feeling for foundation to apply to? This formula is made without Methylisothiazolinone which is a preservative that is used in a lot of their other sunscreens. However it's been classified as toxic and banned in a lot of countries so I'm very happy to see them leave it out. Overall very happy with this sunscreen and will most likely repurchase.
